content:
incident-bot: PAGER: elevated 5xx and tail latency observed for eu regions starting 2999991095. Services impacted: inference-api, image-transcode. Severity P1. Assigned: @ops_oncall_mika.
ops_oncall_mika: ack, joining. grabbing dashboards. any alerts on networking? :mag:
net-carl: seeing asymmetric packet drops between eu-west-1 and eu-west-2 via our inter-region peering. BGP sessions show intermittent route changes and MTU mismatch warnings on a subset of tunnels.
platform-sre-zoe: tcp retransmits spiking, SYN timeouts up 12x. Some clients report long-lived streams dropping mid-request.
infra-raj: NAT gateways in eu-west-2 are near connection limit; we have retries and connection resets coming from SNAT exhaustion. also observed path MTU discovery failures, likely causing PMTUD blackholing for larger packets.
support-anna: customer reports: BrightHealth and NovaGames seeing 504s and partial responses. getting multiple slack DMs and support tickets.
ops_oncall_mika: immediate mitigations: 1) open new NAT autoscale pool in eu-west-2, 2) enable mtu workaround on peering tunnels, 3) pause region-wide autoscale-triggered deployments. starting step 1 now.
infra-raj: starting scaled NAT cluster:
```bash
# trigger quick NAT pool
aws ec2 create-nat-gateway --subnet-id subnet-xxxx --allocation-id eipalloc-yyy
# attach to nat-proxy group
```
net-carl: applying MTU workaround: lowering tunnel MTU and enabling MSS clamping on edge routers to avoid fragmentation. Command (edge router):
```bash
set interfaces tunnel0 mtu 1350
set firewall mss-clamp maximum 1300
commit
```
platform-sre-zoe: also bumping keepalive on BGP to detect flaps faster; pushing config now.
ops_oncall_mika: opening manual traffic-shift plan: we will divert 20% of EU traffic to eu-central-1 first, then 50 if stable. using traffic-controller override.
incident-bot: ACTION: manual_traffic_shift queued by ops_oncall_mika at 2999991162. ramp: 20/50/100.
ops_oncall_mika: note — don't use DNS failover yet; DNS resolvers are inconsistent due to geo-policy caching. use our edge-router weights.
dns-bot: Route53 health checks currently still reporting eu-west-2 healthy due to synthetic probe hitting smaller packets; health check probe size mismatch with client payload. will add large-payload probe.
net-carl: after MSS clamp and MTU change, we still see ~15% of connections failing due to midstream fragmentation on older Android clients. some edge POPs kept old route next-hops due to control-plane race after the route churn. flushing route cache on POPs now.
platform-sre-zoe: re-registering targets didn't help for connections stuck with ENI state UNAVAILABLE. scheduling ENI bounce for affected hosts.
infra-raj: ENI bounce command executed on 4 hosts in eu-west-2:
```text
aws ec2 detach-network-interface --network-interface-id eni-0aaa
sleep 3
aws ec2 attach-network-interface --network-interface-id eni-0aaa --instance-id i-0bbbb
```
support-anna: posting interim message to customers: "We are investigating a networking issue affecting EU customers resulting in timeouts. Engineers are working on failover and mitigations. We will update in 10 minutes."
customer-ops-liz: received an escalated ticket from NovaGames — can we give them an ETA? they are seeing game sessions drop and need an estimated failover completion time.
ops_oncall_mika: telling them 30-45m for full stabilization, but delivering 15m updates.
net-carl: after ENI bounce and NAT pool addition, connection resets dropped ~60%, but we're still seeing tail 5xx from clients that maintain DNS cached IPs for ~180s. verifier: some ISPs are honoring old DNS sets up to 5 minutes.
ops_oncall_mika: accelerating traffic shift to 50% now. monitor for overload in eu-central-1.
incident-bot: TRAFFIC SHIFT: ramp to 50% executed at 2999991238 by ops_oncall_mika.
platform-sre-zoe: eu-central-1 CPU and request queues within acceptable range. 5xx rate down to 25% of peak. latency p95 improved by 400ms.
net-carl: pushing forced route re-advertise and clearing stale peer caches. also scheduling a control-plane fix to prevent race on route withdraws.
ops_oncall_mika: handing off to @ops_oncall_maya for watch/cleanup. summary for handoff: NAT pool scaled, MTU/MSS clamp applied, ENI bounces, manual traffic-shift at 50%, residual 5xx due to DNS caching and some legacy clients.
pagerduty-bot: ONCALL HANDOFF: ops_oncall_mika -> ops_oncall_maya at 2999991285.
ops_oncall_maya: ack, taking over. will proceed to 100% once 10m stable and customer reports improve.
dns-bot: adding large-payload health check now (HTTP probe with 8k payload) to better reflect client experience. update applied.
customer-ops-liz: thanks. NovaGames confirmed partial improvement in sessions after 35m; BrightHealth still reports timeouts for a small subset of regions.
platform-sre-zoe: continuing to drain remaining stuck connections by incrementally increasing connection timeout window and sending RST to hung sockets where possible.
ops_oncall_maya: ramp to 100% at 2999991355 after 12m stable at 50%. monitoring.
incident-bot: INCIDENT MITIGATED: traffic successfully shifted, eu-west-2 showing recovery. severity reduced to P2 at 2999991380. Please create postmortem and assign owners for: 1) MTU and PMTUD handling, 2) NAT autoscale safeguards, 3) DNS failover probe size and TTL guidance, 4) control-plane route re-advertise automation.
support-anna: posted final customer update and status page entry. will follow up with enterprise SRE contacts for BrightHealth.
ops_oncall_maya: creating postmortem doc and scheduling RCA meeting with networking and infra leads. thanks all for quick coordination. :pray:
